position: Founder authorization is a bounded decision record, not an invitation, participant, session, credential, or launch
headline: Five exact proofs can authorize one private session while every execution switch remains off.
copy: The current repository demonstrates the decision contract only. A real go decision would still require live-stack evidence and a separate audited invitation step outside this release.

postures.title: Founder evaluator
postures.copy: Approve, reject, blocked, and unsafe states are covered.

postures.title: Evidence chain
postures.copy: Activation, dry run, revocation, sandbox, and incident evidence remain separate.

postures.title: Execution
postures.copy: No invitation, credential, participant, or session is created.

flow.title: Gather
flow.copy: Verify all five exact evidence states.

flow.title: Bound
flow.copy: Name owners, cap one participant and one session, and expire within seventy-two hours.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Authorize one bounded session, reject, or remain blocked.

flow.title: Hold
flow.copy: Keep invitation issuance, session start, credentials, and public access off.

decisions.label: Decision contract
decisions.reason: Safe and unsafe founder decisions are deterministic.

decisions.label: Current execution
decisions.reason: The interface contains no live activation control.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: Private validation never implies public availability.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Only pseudonymous identifiers are accepted; direct identity is rejected.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No token, email, delivery, or live invitation is created.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No participant account or real session exists.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external provider, notification, or durable participant write is touched.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private validation cannot open public access.
